statements.status_notes: Upstream GHSA-34c7-r8w9-5wv8 (https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories/GHSA-34c7-r8w9-5wv8) covers atom exhaustion through the PUT /api/users tags list. It lists the RabbitMQ 3.13 to 4.3 lines as affected and does not list the 4.4 series. Its version ranges name 4.3.1 as the fixed 4.3 release; its text says 4.3.0, but validate_tag_count/1 first appears in the v4.3.1 tag. In the v4.4.0 and v4.4.1 release tags of rabbitmq-server, set_tags/3 in deps/rabbit/src/rabbit_auth_backend_internal.erl rejects more than 32 tags (validate_tag_count/1) and stores tags as binaries once the rabbitmq_4.4.0 feature flag is enabled. This package installs the GPG-verified upstream rabbitmq-server-generic-unix release. Its only published build, on amd64 and arm64, is 4.4.1-0, which ships RabbitMQ 4.4.1 (in the amd64 build, its plugin directories are rabbit-4.4.1, rabbitmq_management-4.4.1, rabbitmq_auth_backend_oauth2-4.4.1 and amqp10_common-4.4.1). That build carries the fix, so the range is fixed at 4.4.1-0.

Upstream GHSA-34c7-r8w9-5wv8 (https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories/GHSA-34c7-r8w9-5wv8) covers atom exhaustion through the PUT /api/users tags list. It lists the RabbitMQ 3.13 to 4.3 lines as affected and does not list the 4.4 series. Its version ranges name 4.3.1 as the fixed 4.3 release; its text says 4.3.0, but validate_tag_count/1 first appears in the v4.3.1 tag. In the v4.4.0 and v4.4.1 release tags of rabbitmq-server, set_tags/3 in deps/rabbit/src/rabbit_auth_backend_internal.erl rejects more than 32 tags (validate_tag_count/1) and stores tags as binaries once the rabbitmq_4.4.0 feature flag is enabled. This package installs the GPG-verified upstream rabbitmq-server-generic-unix release. Its published builds, on amd64 and arm64, are 4.4.0-0, which ships RabbitMQ 4.4.0 (in the amd64 build, its plugin directories are rabbit-4.4.0, rabbitmq_management-4.4.0, rabbitmq_auth_backend_oauth2-4.4.0 and amqp10_common-4.4.0), and 4.4.1-0, 4.4.1-1 and 4.4.1-2, which ship RabbitMQ 4.4.1. Every published build carries the fix, so the range starts fixed at the lowest one, 4.4.0-0.
